title: Source
description: Where this service's code or image comes from. Saving doesn't touch what's running: deploy to apply it.
savedHint: It takes effect at the next deploy.
imageHint: From any registry, for example ghcr.io/owner/app:1.2.
passwordStored: A password is stored. Leave this blank to keep it, or clear the username to remove both.
branchHint: A branch, a tag or a full commit hash.
pathHint: The folder to build from. Useful in a monorepo.

git.urlHint: An https:// or ssh:// address, or user@host:path.

github.tokenWarning: Private repositories need a GitHub token.

dockerfile.label: Dockerfile
dockerfile.hint: Built as it is, with nothing else in its context.

upload.drop: Drop an archive of your code here, or choose a file
upload.formats: zip, tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz, tar.zst, 7z or rar, up to {{limit}}

build.title: Build
build.description: How the code becomes an image. With nothing chosen, a Dockerfile in the build path is used if there is one, and Nixpacks otherwise.
build.savedHint: They take effect at the next build.
build.skippedHint: The next build detects what to use.

descriptions.dockerfile: Build from a Dockerfile in the repository.
descriptions.buildpacks: Detect the stack and build it with a Cloud Native Buildpacks builder.
descriptions.nixpacks: Detect the stack and build it with Nixpacks.
descriptions.railpack: Detect the stack and build it with Railpack.

build.fileHint: Relative to the build path, which is also the Docker context.
build.commandHint: Set a command to replace the detected one.
build.misePackagesHint: Separated by spaces, as name or name@version.
build.deployAptPackages: APT packages in the final image

sshKey.title: SSH key
sshKey.description: A private repository needs a key. Generate one, then add its public half to the repository on your Git host, as a read-only deploy key.
sshKey.generatedHint: Add its public half to your Git host.
sshKey.refreshDescription: The current key stops working for this service at once, so add the new one to your Git host before the next deploy.

autoDeploy.title: Auto-deploy
autoDeploy.label: Deploy on every push to {{branch}}
autoDeploy.hint: Adds a webhook to the repository. The GitHub token needs permission to manage webhooks.

errors.imageInvalid: Enter an image such as name:tag.
errors.refRequired: Enter a branch, tag or commit.
errors.refInvalid: That isn't a branch, tag or commit name git would accept.
errors.urlRequired: Enter the address of the repository.
errors.urlInvalid: Use an https:// or ssh:// address, or user@host:path.
errors.pathRequired: Enter a folder, or / for the whole repository.
errors.pathInvalid: Use a folder inside the repository, such as /apps/web.
errors.fileType: Use a zip, tar, 7z or rar archive.
